findings.claim: The saturated bounded Reference graph now has an explicit 120-row identity frontier matrix: 23 identities have current source-fenced mappings and 97 have no direct mapping in the exact ten-owner pilot.
No-direct-mapping is a bounded current-pilot fact, not a claim of Ordivon untouchedness, historical absence, novelty, or research priority.

Frontier Matrix v0 exposed eleven normalized identities with no MajorRegion placement; disposition audit placed all eleven in existing regions with zero breadth reopen, zero new MajorRegions, unchanged anchors and zero new coverage mappings.

After navigation debt repair, the frontier overlay partitions the 97 current no-mapping identities into 22 unmapped anchors (A), 20 cross-region members (B), and 55 single-region members (C); these are navigation inspection classes, not epistemic importance scores.

Owner frontier states remain orthogonal to identity frontier states: Host is current/external-mapping-weak, Game is current/out-of-bounded-scope, while Finance and Harness are publication-unavailable and therefore not scoreable as untouched.

A stale seven-owner untouched-candidate field was removed from current crosswalk v0.8 because several historical candidates later gained mappings and, more fundamentally, mapping absence never entailed untouchedness.

The highest-information next work is to investigate frontier state quality through owner-authority unlocks, direct-scope/non-lifting tests and weak-mapping residuals rather than resume breadth catalog growth.

next: Complete acceptance/durability for Frontier v0.1. Then choose bounded frontier dogfood: Finance authority unlock when transport is available, Host weak-mapping irreducibility comparison, or a deliberate no-lift inspection such as Biology/Philosophy. Do not interpret A/B/C as an automatic research roadmap.
